thread:
maria: heads up, observed repeated OOMs on paged-attn when batch size spikes after deploy.
devin: saw that. what's the failure mode? mem fragmentation?
satoshi: any repro or logs?
maria: yes. profiler shows many small free blocks in block manager after compaction. GPU mem usage high, allocator forces new allocations -> OOM.
devin: can you paste the nsys snippet?
maria: perf-bot posted:
perf-bot: [auto-profile] 1715127895 nsys summary: kernel: paged_attn_loop avg 3.2ms, alloc failures 24, cudaMalloc retries 12, compaction time 48ms
maria: snippet:
```text
[blockmgr] compaction: scanned 14 blocks, moved 9, freed 2, alloc_retry=3
allocator: free_list: 64B x 120, 4KB x 2, 256KB x 0
```
devin: hmm free_list has lots of tiny fragments; workspace sized to 128MB but we see repeated 256KB hole creation from block reuse policy
alice: did we regressed kernel selection? might be picking non-optimized kernels for certain seq-lens after PR #488
satoshi: checked. kernel selector fallback count up after 2024-05-10 deploy. selector chooses generic_strided path for seq<len 128 when power diagram mismatches.
maria: experiment: tuned block size from 64KB to 32KB reduced compaction cost but increased bookkeeping overhead. ran A/B:
perf-bot: A: block_size=64KB YCS=default: p99 latency 123ms, compaction_time=48ms, OOMs=3
perf-bot: B: block_size=32KB YCS=default: p99 latency 118ms, compaction_time=18ms, OOMs=0
devin: nice. any downside?
maria: more meta allocations but overall memory footprints smoother. However observed increased kernel switch when batch mixing short/long sequences -> kernel selector needs tuning to prefer fused kernels when block reuse high.
alice: proposal: add a quick steady-state pass that consolidates free tiny slots into larger spans without full compaction; heuristics: only when free_ratio > 0.3 and avg_block_age > 5s
satoshi: also suggest adaptive workspace resizing: shrink workspace on low-beta usage to reduce fragmentation, expand lazily.
devin: action items:
- maria: prototype consolidation pass + unit test (memhole_reducer)
- satoshi: add kernel selector telemetry for mixed-batch runs
- alice: run regression test across 5 model profiles
maria: I'll push branch later today. sample command:
```bash
./run_local_profile.sh --bsize=64 --seq=1,64,512 --workspaces=auto
```
devin: FYI, can we also expose a debug flag to force block_size for perf experiments? helps prod toggles.
maria: yep will add ENV BLOCKMGR_BLOCK_SIZE override.
alice: :thumbsup:
maria: will update when I have numbers. thanks.
